issues.finding: Continue observer sampled the old playback index during the reviewed return bridge, before resumePlayback advanced the completed check-in.
issues.evidence: offline-attempt02/stress-browser-result.json: 42/44 checks; s05 and final question return checks sampled identical old origin/playback while the final natural route check passed.
issues.solution: Wait until the bridge caption has ended; then assert the expected next route index or natural closing after the last check-in.

issues.evidence: offline-attempt02/stress-browser-result.json has14 session turns and15 observed response packets, including utterance_id stale-synthetic.
issues.solution: Each response packet now has provenance live_api_result, offline_synthetic, or injected_stale_test; report totals distinguish these categories.

issues.finding: Review found a duplicate ended-save could claim success after the single upstream save failed, because only the attempted content digest existed.
issues.evidence: stress_contract.py::test_failed_upstream_save_stays_failed_on_duplicate_without_retry; fake failed upstream, two client saves, exactly one upstream POST.
issues.solution: Persist the failed or unknown save outcome; duplicate requests return failure, and an in-progress save returns conflict instead of a fabricated success. No retry or extra summary is dispatched.
issues.status: Corrected; focused guard contracts9/9 with0outbound. Existing44/44 browser success path unchanged.

issues.finding: The client evaluation marker did not prevent synthetic interruption timestamps from entering the production interruption aggregate; synthetic input clocks could also look like measured STT.
issues.evidence: stress_contract.py::test_authoritative_save_excludes_synthetic_audio_and_interruption_kpis compares the exact forwarded record using production runtime_metrics.aggregate: original fixture supplies one audio and one interruption sample; sanitized record supplies neither.
issues.solution: The proxy authoritatively clears all voice-input, endpoint, audio and interruption timestamps before its one permitted save. Interruption counts, phases, response classification and actual qa_done remain; synthetic clock values are preserved in evaluation/turn evidence and the browser sidecar.
